title: <jemalloc>: Unsupported system page size on aarch64 using docker images
body:
I am trying to start qdrant/qdrant:v1.9.2 docker image on an arm64 machine (a cloud machine with Kunpeng920 CPU and 16 Gigabyte RAM).
Fails with memory allocation error.

**It seems this issue was resolved on issue #2474 , but it appears on v1.9.2**

## Current Behavior
```shell
<jemalloc>: Unsupported system page size
<jemalloc>: Unsupported system page size
memory allocation of 5 bytes failed
./entrypoint.sh: line 25:     7 Aborted                 (core dumped) ./qdrant $@
```

## Steps to Reproduce
```
docker run -p 6333:6333 -p 6334:6334 \
    -v $(pwd)/qdrant_storage:/qdrant/storage:z \
    qdrant/qdrant:v1.9.2
```

## Expected Behavior
Should properly start.

## Build on source

i also try to build from source, but it failed with error as follows:

```docker buildx build --no-cache --platform linux/arm64 -t qdrant .```

```shell
DEPRECATED: The legacy builder is deprecated and will be removed in a future release.
            Install the buildx component to build images with BuildKit:
            https://docs.docker.com/go/buildx/

 ---> 7f9d10a7b485

Step 5/50 : COPY . .
failed to get destination image "sha256:83dbe3c2f54b523abfbbfc8310b86082c632c144c711275e25106f50ded60eb1": image with reference sha256:83dbe3c2f54b523abfbbfc8310b86082c632c144c711275e25106f50ded60eb1 was found but does not match the specified platform: wanted linux/arm64, actual: linux/amd64
```
